events.verdict: Fox (SAC) makes marginal contact with Caldwell-Pope's (LAL) body, but doesn't affect his SQBR or knock him off his direct path towards the basket.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes marginal contact with Caldwell-Pope's (LAL) arm but does not affect his driving shot attempt.
McGee (LAL) is in the paint for more then 3 seconds without actively guarding an opponent.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes some contact with Ingram's (LAL) shoulder during the pick but he is able to move through contact.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes marginal contact with McGee (LAL), but doesn't affect his ability to rebound.
LLS shows McGee (LAL) initially establishes a legal position in Shumpert's (SAC) path, but then extends his leg further, creating contact with Shumpert as he tries to avoid the screen.
Shumpert (SAC) makes contact with Ingram's (LAL) arm during his drive and loses control of the ball.
Shumpert (SAC) put two hands on Ingram's (LAL) body and initiates contact that affects his ability to maintain control of the ball.
Ingram (LAL) maintains verticality on Shumpert's (SAC) shot attempt in transition.
Fox (SAC) maintains verticality on Hart's (LAL) drive shot attempt.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) firms up and absorbs the contact from Caldwell-Pope (LAL) during the pick.
[Observable in enhanced video] Bogdanovic (SAC) moves his pivot foot after his gather at the end of his dribble.
[Observable in enhanced video] Cauley-Stein (SAC) fails to fully clear and is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Hield (SAC) makes marginal contact with Kuzma (LAL) in the backcourt.
Shumpert (SAC) makes contact with Kuzma's (LAL) arm and loses control of the ball.
